name: ui-apexpages-page-state-messages-runtime

source.content: ApexPages.addMessage(new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Summary', 'Detail')); try { Integer quotient = 1 / 0; System.assertEquals(0, quotient); } catch (Exception e) { ApexPages.addMessages(e); } System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR)); System.assert(!ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.INFO)); System.assertEquals(2, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); ApexPages.addMessages(new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.WARNING, 'Warning', 'Warning detail')); System.assertEquals(3, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.WARNING));
